provision: xcrun simctl list runtimes | grep -q 'iOS 27' || xcodebuild -downloadPlatform iOS

git clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/millianlmx/swimmich "$HOME/warm" && cd "$HOME/warm" && { SWIMMICH_CI_UI_SCOPE=gate SWIMMICH_CI_UI_WORKERS=2 Scripts/ci.sh || echo 'préchauffage : la porte a échoué, ses caches restent'; } && rm -rf "$HOME/warm"

tests.touched: git init -q && git add -A && git -c user.name=omp -c user.email=omp@harness commit -qm arbre --no-verify && git update-ref refs/remotes/origin/main HEAD && SWIMMICH_CI_UI_SCOPE=gate SWIMMICH_CI_UI_WORKERS=2 Scripts/ci.sh
